# MapLibre stylesheet

`maplibre-gl-6.9.0.css` is copied unchanged from
https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@6.9.0/dist/maplibre-gl.css.

The homepage embeds it to avoid a render-blocking third-party request on mobile.
Update it alongside the pinned MapLibre JavaScript version in `html/map.html`.
The upstream license is published at `static/vendor/maplibre-gl-LICENSE.txt`.
